en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings. On the left corner is a building with the shop sign "A.W. Hofmann" and German advertising for sewing machines and steel goods. The street curves into the distance with tram tracks and a few pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles. The upper margin bears the printed red title "Riesa a. d. Elbe. Wettinerstrasse." and the right margin credits the publisher.
